read.thesis: The document is an annual report extract (FY26 financials, governance and compliance), not a Q2 FY27 call; no prior guidance is repeated, so the margin, working-capital and country-liquor targets cannot be checked.

red_flags.quote: The matter was subsequently settled, and the Company and its Managing Director received Settlement Order Nos.

summary.headline: BCL Industries FY26 standalone PAT rose 14.6% to ₹8,197 lakh on revenue of ₹2,00,640 lakh; FY26 dividend recommended at 35%.
summary.overview: The document is FY26 annual report material (Director's Report, BRSR, audited standalone and consolidated statements), not a Q2 FY27 earnings call transcript, so it contains no quarterly commentary or management Q&A. Standalone FY26 revenue from operations was ₹2,00,640 lakh (down 2.8% YoY) while profit before tax rose 13.6% to ₹10,732 lakh and PAT rose 14.6% to ₹8,197 lakh. Svaksha Distillery became a wholly owned subsidiary from 1 July 2026 after the company bought the remaining 25% stake. Capital work-in-progress of ₹24,612 lakh was capitalised during FY26, mainly ethanol capacity, and borrowings rose.

financial_highlights.change: up from ₹37,212.00 lakh... see note: non-current ₹21,814.79 lakh vs ₹17,503.94 lakh; current ₹13,042.72 lakh vs ₹19,708.06 lakh

financial_highlights.value: 35% on face value of ₹1 (about ₹1,033.07 lakh outflow)

segments.name: Maize Oil Extraction & Refinery (standalone, external sales)
segments.commentary: External sales of ₹74,936.58 lakh in FY26 versus ₹98,104.91 lakh in FY25, with segment profit before tax of ₹1,759.44 lakh versus ₹1,166.09 lakh.

segments.name: Oil Trading
segments.commentary: Segment reported in FY26 with external sales of ₹13,850.62 lakh versus nil in FY25 in the segment table; note that the annual report also shows a separate oil trading line with ₹488.00 lakh of external sales.

segments.name: Distillery
segments.commentary: External sales of ₹1,12,181.93 lakh versus ₹1,08,457.98 lakh, with segment profit before tax of ₹10,101.10 lakh versus ₹9,243.96 lakh; the largest and most profitable segment.

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.commentary: External sales of ₹488.00 lakh versus ₹853.39 lakh; segment profit before tax of ₹139.48 lakh, with FY26 rental income of ₹277.43 lakh versus ₹620.08 lakh.

guidance_outlook: No forward-looking guidance on FY27 revenue, margins or volumes is given in the document.
Dividend of 35% (₹0.35 per ₹1 share) recommended, subject to AGM approval.
Government ethanol blending steps (E22, E25, E27, E30 excise exemptions; E85/E100 draft rules) are cited as demand tailwinds, but the company gives no volume outlook.
capex_capacity: Capital work-in-progress fell to ₹402.27 lakh at 31 March 2026 from ₹10,016.24 lakh; ₹22,289.33 lakh (standalone) was capitalised in FY26.
Gross PPE rose to ₹71,236.80 lakh from ₹53,840.48 lakh; net PPE is ₹51,889.89 lakh versus ₹34,175.69 lakh.
New 200 KLPD ethanol plant is financed by Canara Bank (outstanding ₹8,558 lakh total) and a new 150 KLPD ethanol plant by SBI term loan (₹6,764.07 lakh).
Consolidated notes show FNCB term loans for a proposed 100 KLPD expansion at Dakshin Simla, West Bengal (₹3,999.98 lakh).
Borrowing cost capitalised in FY26 was ₹375.58 lakh standalone (₹435.18 lakh consolidated).
demand_pricing: Standalone revenue declined about 2.9% YoY while cost of materials consumed fell to ₹1,29,882.91 lakh from ₹1,54,893.96 lakh.
Purchases of stock-in-trade of ₹13,711.13 lakh appear in FY26 versus nil in FY25, consistent with the oil trading line.
Inventories fell to ₹24,179.65 lakh from ₹37,589.97 lakh, releasing working capital.
Trade payables fell to ₹3,345.40 lakh from ₹11,468.27 lakh; trade payable discounting dropped to ₹1,864.08 lakh from ₹8,500.61 lakh.
risks_watch: Total debt rose: non-current borrowings up 24.6% to ₹21,814.79 lakh, funding ethanol capacity; current borrowings fell to ₹13,042.72 lakh from ₹19,708.06 lakh.
SEBI show-cause and settlement: company paid ₹14.30 lakh and the Managing Director ₹28.60 lakh (settlement order March 2025).
Exchange penalties for late related-party and governance filings (₹20,000 plus GST; ₹5,000 plus GST; ₹23,600) were paid.
Ethanol policy dependence: blending roadmap beyond E20 is not yet formalised by government.
Consolidated Note 36.1 contingent liabilities on disputed tax are noted but not quantified in the material reviewed.
Q2 FY27 results and management commentary were not in the document; a separate earnings transcript is needed.
summary.management_tone: Not applicable: the document contains no management commentary or call Q&A. The tone of the regulatory and governance disclosures is formal and procedural.
key_quotes: The Board of Directors have recommended an equity dividend of 35% on face value of Rs.1/- each i.e. for the financial year ended March 31, 2026

New 150 KLPD ethanol plant (financed by SBI term loan ₹6,764.07 lakh)

It shows FY26 standalone revenue down ~2.9% with PAT up 14.6%, ethanol capacity additions (200 and 150 KLPD under construction, 100 KLPD proposed) financed but with no commissioning timeline or volume outlook given.
